subject: Annual CDBG CAPER Hearing
overview: The Community Development Board held a public hearing to review accomplishments and expenditures from the prior year's Community Development Block Grant and to solicit public feedback.

items.title: Public Hearing on the CDBG Consolidated Annual Performance Evaluation Report
items.summary: CDBG Manager Laurel Siegel presented the city's accomplishments and $1.1 million in expenditures for the prior program year, then closed the hearing after receiving no public comments.
